en.shortDescription: Collabora Online office suite for Nextcloud
en.longDescription:
Nextcloud Office runs Collabora Online (CODE) for in-browser editing of documents, spreadsheets, and presentations with Nextcloud.

Set NEXTCLOUD_OFFICE_NC_DOMAIN to your Nextcloud host. In the Nextcloud Collabora Online / richdocuments admin settings, use SERVICE_URL_NEXTCLOUD_OFFICE as the office server URL. Admin console credentials are SERVICE_USER_COLABORA / SERVICE_PASSWORD_COLABORA. Reverse proxy must support WebSockets on port 9980.

de.longDescription:

Setze NEXTCLOUD_OFFICE_NC_DOMAIN auf deinen Nextcloud-Host. In den Nextcloud Collabora Online / richdocuments-Admin-Einstellungen nutze SERVICE_URL_NEXTCLOUD_OFFICE als Office-Server-URL. Admin-Zugangsdaten sind SERVICE_USER_COLABORA / SERVICE_PASSWORD_COLABORA. Der Reverse Proxy muss WebSockets auf Port 9980 unterstützen.

fr.shortDescription: Suite bureautique Collabora Online pour Nextcloud
fr.longDescription:
Nextcloud Office exécute Collabora Online (CODE) pour éditer documents, tableurs et présentations dans le navigateur avec Nextcloud.

Définissez NEXTCLOUD_OFFICE_NC_DOMAIN sur l'hôte Nextcloud. Dans les réglages admin Collabora Online / richdocuments, utilisez SERVICE_URL_NEXTCLOUD_OFFICE comme URL du serveur Office. Identifiants admin : SERVICE_USER_COLABORA / SERVICE_PASSWORD_COLABORA. Le reverse proxy doit prendre en charge les WebSockets sur le port 9980.

pt.shortDescription: Suite office Collabora Online para Nextcloud
pt.longDescription:
Nextcloud Office executa o Collabora Online (CODE) para editar documentos, folhas de cálculo e apresentações no browser com o Nextcloud.

Defina NEXTCLOUD_OFFICE_NC_DOMAIN para o host do Nextcloud. Nas definições de admin do Collabora Online / richdocuments, use SERVICE_URL_NEXTCLOUD_OFFICE como URL do servidor Office. Credenciais de admin: SERVICE_USER_COLABORA / SERVICE_PASSWORD_COLABORA. O reverse proxy deve suportar WebSockets na porta 9980.
